text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King. Allow me to report. Regarding my 
life as a knight thus far...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's time for a review. I decided to have 
Durandal summarize everything up until 
now.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the race results alone were 
passable. However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
âDamage report: Tea cup set, two pairs. 
Arita ware plates, two.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—Stockpile report. Surplus food inventory: 
2 months' worth. Long-life emergency 
rations: 3 months' worth.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
And... the training reports. All those 
race records where the timing to make a 
move went wrong...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
That is all. How utterly inexperienced of 
me... I am terribly sorry...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I can hardly say that was very 
knightly... If anything, I feel like I'm 
losing my composure more and more."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Do I... lack the talent to be a knight?
choice_data_list: I don't really think that's true, though.
I don't really think that's true, though.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much... However, I do not 
originally come from... a distinguished 
family line.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Born into an ordinary family, I am merely 
someone who yearned deeply to be a 
knight...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, I cannot help feeling that 
“dignity” is the one thing lacking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unless you make a conscious effort to 
change, how you act and carry yourself in 
crucial moments is inevitably shaped by 
your upbringing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True royalty and nobility. The dignity and 
composure possessed by such individuals 
are—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is not something that can be acquired 
in a day or two. It is something that 
wells up from the deepest parts of one's 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Durandal does not possess such profound 
dignity. In that case—
choice_data_list: We might need someone to teach us.
We might need someone to teach us.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Someone to teach me... About poise and 
dignity, you mean?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, you have to understand the root of 
it.

Yeah, I need to understand the 
fundamentals first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The mentality of those of high status. I 
had no choice but to somehow seek guidance 
from someone who truly understood it.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! If it's an instructor in 
grace and dignity you need, I know just 
the person.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: If only I could ask for their guidance...
choice_data_list: Who do you mean by "that person"?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Her fellow classmate—Her Highness Fine 
Motion. She is...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
She is of royal descent and stands on the 
stage of high society. However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Considering she is quite busy with 
official duties, I wonder how much of her 
time she will be able to spare...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course I know about Fine Motion. I've 
spoken with her before, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Getting thorough, dedicated coaching would 
be a whole different story. Still, I 
decided to ask anyway.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Members of the press, please step aside. 
It is now time for the young lady to head 
to school.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
All physical contact is strictly 
prohibited today. Please step back.
choice_data_list: Fine, do you have a sec!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? You are...

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
――!? Step back. I believe I said all 
contact is strictly prohibited.
choice_data_list: I have a favor to ask, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Persistent! If you approach without 
permission...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Permission granted.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Your Highness? However, letting such 
a suspicious person...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
They are not a suspicious person. That 
is—Durandal's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
He is the king to whom that obstinate 
knight offered her sword. She would never, 
ever be impolite to him. ...Right?♪

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: Mmm... If Your Highness says so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we somehow managed to negotiate in 
person—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Good day, Durandal♪

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Fine-san...! I never imagined you'd 
actually come..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Because Trainer was just so enthusiastic.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I, Fine Motion, was truly struck by your 
passion. ...Just kidding!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All I could do was ask. I'm truly glad 
Fine Motion is such an open-minded 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Fine-san, I come from a commoner 
background, so I just can't seem to 
acquire true elegance no matter what."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't panic. But when the critical 
moment comes, I always end up losing my 
composure...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I want to be more knightly. Always 
majestic and dignified...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yet, I cannot do it... I feel like I 
cannot move forward unless I solve this 
problem first.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see, you were really troubled by that, 
weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, by the way, have you decided on 
our next target race yet?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal will soon enter the Classic 
class. When it comes to the race 
representing the sprint division for the 
Classic class, it has to be THAT race."
choice_data_list:
I was thinking of aiming for next spring's 
NHK Mile Cup

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"The NHK Mile Cup...! A prestigious 1,600m 
GⅠ!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If you are aiming for that, then it is all 
the more reason to refine your elegance 
and poise...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"As I am now, I would only be overwhelmed 
by its prestige and make a fool of 
myself."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, that's true... Whether in high 
society or diplomacy, if you feel out of 
place, you'll never fulfill your role 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it! Then I'll teach you the 
right mindset for succeeding on the big 
stage. And then—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll look into it. What Durandal is 
missing to become a proper knight, that 
is.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! I know plenty of people with 
genuine knightly titles. If I ask, they 
might give us some advice.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, so many people I actually know! How 
reassuring...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness, it is an honor. Please, 
teach me what it truly means to be a 
knight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Durandal bowed respectfully. And so, her 
knightly training toward the NHK Mile Cup 
began.
